name: gram-suvidha-monorepo
description: Gram Suvidha - Rural Civic Issue Reporting & Gram Panchayat Governance Platform

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "green,cyan" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build
